overlap_policy: Easy/moderate overlap in positive constants; polynomial coefficient fingerprints are excluded globally. Variable, response shape, p-sign convention, bank, option order and seed never add variants.

exceptions.evidence: Exact source banks replay, but distractor intent is opaque. Evidence-only profiles excluded from new content; default authored complete method bank is explicitly documented.
Original missing answer/solution/difficulty facts are preserved. Generated same-method instances have complete validated fields and authored keys.
h integer 1..12, c integer 1..144 easy or 0..144 moderate; h3..12 and c-60..-1 hard; residual nonzero. Radio h1 bank collision is rejected; blank h1 supported.
